name: decluttering-method
description:
Guides users through systematic decluttering using category-based or room-based
methods. Provides decision frameworks for what to keep, donate, or discard,
with specific criteria for common item types. Includes time estimates per
category and strategies for maintaining a decluttered space. Use when the user
asks about decluttering, reducing possessions, organizing before a move, or
creating more space in their home. Do NOT use for regular cleaning routines
(use weekly-cleaning-schedule), professional organizing services for hoarding
situations, or room layout and furniture arrangement (use room-organization-system).
